# CN Evidence — China company data and screening reports

Standard example: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/standard-report-example.html (English) and https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/standard-report-example-zh.html (Chinese). Historical identity-redacted internal acceptance extract, not a customer case, full original report or API response schema. No live query or wallet required. Bounded pilot guide: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/integration-pilot.html.

Product IDs: screening-standard-v1 (0.29 USDC; 10 fixed Jinghai-first check dimensions, JSON plus Chinese and English HTML reports); screening-enhanced-v1 (0.59 USDC; same 10 dimensions plus one QCC qualifications lookup, up to 30 records). Only if administrative-license tool v3_license_list has a connection/call failure or is already circuit-open, make one QCC operation/get_administrative_license fallback (3 points, up to 100 records, no paging/retry). Enhanced always includes its separate qualifications lookup, so QCC calls are capped at 1 for Standard and 2 for Enhanced. Preserve the Jinghai failure and QCC source; license evidence is partial and does not claim completeness. No other checks fall back; this is not fallback for all 64 tools. Other check failures or failure of both providers prevent settlement. qcc-qualifications-v1 (0.03 USDC; canonical JSON only, up to 30 records, no report analysis). All are HTTP x402 only, not new MCP tools. Historical paid acceptance was under an earlier contract version; the current contract has not had a new funded acceptance. Overview, conditions and current acceptance status: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/products.html; live catalog: https://api.cnevidence.com/free/cn/products. Delivery depends on provider balance and runtime availability. There is no manual daily or total commercial quota; per-order limits and availability conditions still apply.

Current V3: 64 individual data tools deployed; MCP tools/list returns 68 total (64 data tools, 3 older tools, one schema helper). The authoritative current catalog and schemas are https://api.cnevidence.com/free/cn/tools; same-origin OpenAPI: https://api.cnevidence.com/openapi.json. V3 guide: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/v3-tools.html. Each new V3 call is 0.011 USDC. On 2026-10-10, one owner-funded HTTP v3_company_detail purchase passed payment, settlement, delivery and free recovery checks. This is not a customer sale or paid acceptance of all 64 tools or the V3 MCP transport. Do not imply all 104 upstream tools are available. Delivery depends on provider balance and runtime availability; there is no manual daily or total commercial quota, but per-order limits and delivery conditions remain.

Failure handling: no automatic repayment, upstream business retry or non-equivalent legacy substitution. Repeated failures temporarily pause the affected tool. Before purchase save a unique 64-hex recovery token and send X-CN-Recovery-Token on the paid POST. Free recovery: POST https://api.cnevidence.com/free/cn/payment/recover with JSON {"recovery_token":"YOUR_SAVED_64_HEX_SECRET","include_report":true}, no payment signature. HTTP 200 alone is not proof of delivery: state failed_before_settlement carries no report, while a settled report must be checked in the body. Unknown/interrupted payment status requires reconciliation, not a new payment. Report recovery window: 24 hours. Refund review is not a completed or guaranteed refund. Details: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/v3-tools.html#failure-recovery

Readable fictional supplier-check example (documentation only, not an automatic risk assessment or live query): https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/sample-report.html

Paid lookup: a plain MCP connection cannot purchase data without an x402 payment client, funded Base USDC wallet and spending authorization.
The buyer guide includes the guarded V3 company-detail purchase example as well as the retained legacy Basic/Full packages. Other V3 tool schemas and integration details are documented at https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/v3-tools.html.
Buyer guide and exact-identity input instructions: https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/buyer-guide.html
Free fictional sample (no live query): https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/sample-report.json

CN Evidence provides structured Chinese company information for supplier verification and due diligence. The old local procurement/regulatory dataset is retired from active service. Existing API URLs and MCP tool names remain available.

## Legacy Basic and Full packages (not the whole current catalog)

| Package | USDC per successful report | Included modules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | 0.032 | Registration, operating abnormalities, administrative penalties |
| Full | 0.093 | Basic plus serious violations, enforcement, dishonesty, bankruptcy, qualifications, customs |

One interface can return many fields and records: Full means nine modules, not nine fields. Each list is limited to its first page, up to ten records. Serious violations, enforcement and dishonesty use the current-status option. No automatic historical queries, pagination or retries.

Upstream nominal costs are CNY 0.15 / 0.45. Prices use a fixed budgeting assumption of 7 CNY/USDC and upward rounding; this is not a live FX quote. Trial credits do not lower the published retail prices.

## Existing entrypoints

- [x402 API](https://api.cnevidence.com)
- [Live OpenAPI](https://api.cnevidence.com/openapi.json)
- [Agent manifest](https://api.cnevidence.com/.well-known/agent.json)
- [x402 discovery](https://api.cnevidence.com/.well-known/x402)
- [Remote MCP](https://mcp.cnevidence.com/mcp)

Basic: GET /x402/cn/supplier/evidence/basic?uscc=YOUR_USCC  
Full: POST /x402/cn/supplier/evidence with JSON {"uscc":"YOUR_USCC"}  
Alternatively supply the exact Chinese legal company name as "company".

MCP tools: get_china_supplier_evidence_basic (query) and get_china_supplier_evidence_full (request). Both accept an identity object containing company or uscc.

Payment: x402, USDC on Base. Unsigned requests return payment requirements without querying data providers. A funded compatible wallet and explicit spending authorization are needed to buy a report. Native MPP is temporarily paused. The old the402 webhook is paused pending repricing; use the canonical x402/MCP entrypoints.

## Response and limitations

Schema v2 returns schema_version, request_id, tier, provider, queried_at, entity, modules, coverage, usage and limitations. Each module describes its status, data/records and paging uncertainty. Unselected modules are marked not_requested; no_records means only that this query returned no records.

Free entity resolution is retired. The legacy free HTTP resolve route remains a capability notice; the existing resolve_china_company MCP tool now offers local input preflight only, not a database lookup. Free HTTP input preparation: POST https://api.cnevidence.com/free/cn/identity/preflight with company or uscc. input_ready does not mean verified identity; no upstream call or payment occurs. Static examples are schema guides, not live supplier facts. Procurement award history is NOT included in these nine interfaces. Legacy include_evidence/evidence_limit options do not expand coverage; package limits apply.

Data availability depends on provider coverage and update schedules. Preserve any source attribution included in query results. Absence of records is not proof of no risk. No nationwide completeness, fraud score, payment-safety guarantee, bank verification or legal conclusion is provided.

## 中文摘要

当前 V3 提供 64 个单独计费数据工具，每次选定工具调用 0.011 USDC，MCP 共 68 项定义。完整工具范围、参数和限制见 https://yangchunhong3000.github.io/cn-evidence-public-docs/v3-tools.html 。买方指南提供 V3 企业详情购买示例，并非全部工具的通用购买客户端。

以下为保留的旧版 Basic/Full 套餐摘要，不代表当前 V3 的完整目录：Basic 每次 0.032 USDC，包含工商、经营异常、行政处罚；Full 每次 0.093 USDC，另含严重违法、被执行、失信、破产、资质、海关，共九个模块。旧版套餐的每个列表仅首页、最多十条；不含政府采购历史，不自动翻页或补查历史。旧域名及工具名保留；免费实体检索、原生 MPP 和旧 the402 回调暂不提供原服务。没有记录不代表没有风险。以实时 OpenAPI 和支付报价为准。
